statements.impact_statement: MotorOS services expose JSON REST controllers and do not configure XsltView, implicit view rendering, or a wildcard view controller. The XSLT rendering path required by the vendor advisory is absent. See https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47884/. This is an application applicability assessment, not a patched-library claim. Reassess by 2026-11-25 or on any MVC view feature change.

MotorOS does not stream Spring MVC/WebFlux view fragments over SSE and contains no SseEmitter, ResponseBodyEmitter, ModelAndView, or text/event-stream endpoints. The required rendering path is absent. See https://spring.io/security/cve-2026-47890/. Reassess by 2026-11-25 or on any SSE/view feature change.
